basic_info.description: Prepare to be smitten by this delightful gem of a home! Classic Victorian details meet modern updates here in the best part of Noe Valley. Located on the top floor of a circa 1904 building, you'll enjoy warm southern exposure and cozy shelter in the heart of a flourishing neighborhood. The traditional layout encompasses two bedrooms, full bath, formal living room, eat-in kitchen and a flexible-use office/library/guest room. The private deck allows for indoor/outdoor living and is sure to be one of your favorite spots for morning coffee, cracking open a good book or tending garden pots. Throughout the home, signature light fixtures complement the built-in cabinets, hardwood floors, beautiful brick fireplace, original lincrusta and ornate ceiling rosettes.   You'll also appreciate ample basement storage, a shared courtyard and excellent proximity to some of the neighborhood's most enticing shops and restaurants - including those of nearby Bernal Heights and The Mission. Commuters, hop aboard MUNI, Hwy 101 or I-280 within minutes of the front door.  So much to love within these walls!
